dmcaNoticeReceived.subject: Copyright notice about {content}
dmcaNoticeReceived.preview: We received a copyright notice about your content.
dmcaNoticeReceived.heading: We received a copyright notice
dmcaNoticeReceived.body: We received a copyright (DMCA) notice about {content}, and it is no longer available while the notice is handled.
dmcaNoticeReceived.counter: If you believe the notice is a mistake or you have the rights to this content, you can send a counter-notice.
dmcaNoticeDecided.subjectRejected: Your copyright notice {noticeRef} could not be actioned
dmcaNoticeDecided.preview: A decision was made on your copyright (DMCA) notice.
dmcaNoticeDecided.headingActioned: We acted on your copyright notice
dmcaNoticeDecided.headingRejected: We could not act on your copyright notice
dmcaNoticeDecided.bodyActioned: We reviewed your copyright (DMCA) notice {noticeRef} and disabled access to the material it identified.
dmcaNoticeDecided.bodyActionedPartial: We reviewed your copyright (DMCA) notice {noticeRef} and disabled access to the material at {removed} of the {total} locations it identified. The other locations did not point to material we host that was still available.
dmcaNoticeDecided.bodyActionedNone: We reviewed your copyright (DMCA) notice {noticeRef}. None of the locations it identified pointed to material we host that was still available, so nothing was removed.
dmcaNoticeDecided.bodyRejected: We reviewed your copyright (DMCA) notice {noticeRef} and could not act on it as it stands. The note below says what is missing or wrong.
dmcaNoticeDecided.resubmit: You can send a new, complete notice at any time.
dmcaNoticeDecided.policy: Questions about copyright? Write to our designated agent at {contact}.
dmcaCounterNoticeForwarded.subject: Counter-notice received for your copyright notice {noticeRef}
dmcaCounterNoticeForwarded.preview: The uploader sent a counter-notice; here is a copy.
dmcaCounterNoticeForwarded.heading: The uploader sent a counter-notice
dmcaCounterNoticeForwarded.body: The person whose material was removed under your copyright (DMCA) notice {noticeRef} sent the counter-notice below. We are forwarding it to you as the law requires.
dmcaCounterNoticeForwarded.statements: The sender stated, under penalty of perjury, that they believe in good faith the material was removed by mistake or misidentification. They consented to the jurisdiction of the federal district court for their address (or, outside the United States, any judicial district in which we may be found) and agreed to accept service of process from you or your agent.
dmcaCounterNoticeForwarded.restore: We will restore the material after {restoreAfter} unless, before then, you tell our designated agent at {contact} that you have filed a court action seeking to restrain the sender from the infringing activity.
contentRestored.subject: Your content is available again: {content}
contentRestored.preview: Content that was taken down has been restored.
contentRestored.heading: Your content has been restored
appealDecided.subject: Your appeal {appealRef} has been decided
appealDecided.preview: A decision has been made on your appeal.
appealDecided.heading: Your appeal has been decided
appealDecided.outcomeOverturned: Overturned: the original action has been reversed
appealDecided.outcomeUpheld: Upheld: the original action stays in place
appealDecided.final: You can find the reasons and any further options on the decision page.
enforcementStatement.subject: Statement of reasons: {restriction}
enforcementStatement.preview: What we restricted, why, and how you can challenge it.
enforcementStatement.heading: Statement of reasons
enforcementStatement.body: On {appliedAt} we took an action about your {content}. This statement says what we did, why, and how you can challenge it.
enforcementStatement.draft: The wording of this statement comes from a draft notice that has not been reviewed by a lawyer yet. It may change.
enforcementStatement.endsIndefinite: No end date: it stays in place until it is lifted
enforcementStatement.factsClassifierT1: Automated checks found {category} in content captured on {capturedAt}, at or above the threshold of {threshold} set for automatic action.
enforcementStatement.factsClassifierT2: Automated checks found {category} in content captured on {capturedAt}, at or above the threshold of {threshold} set for the mature label.
enforcementStatement.factsReview: A moderator reviewed case {caseRef} and decided: {decision}.
enforcementStatement.factsNcii: We received a request about intimate images on {receivedAt} (request {requestRef}). We had until {deadlineAt} to act on it.
enforcementStatement.factsHash: Content captured on {capturedAt} matched an image on our list of intimate images removed after earlier requests.
enforcementStatement.staffAction.facts: A member of our staff applied this action under {clause} on {appliedAt}. No moderation case was opened for it.
enforcementStatement.sourceLabel: How it came to our attention
enforcementStatement.sourceNotice: A notice from someone else (we do not say who)
enforcementStatement.detectionNo: No software was used to detect it.
enforcementStatement.decisionFully: Software made the decision, without a person.
enforcementStatement.decisionPartially: Software helped a person make the decision.
enforcementStatement.appeal: You can appeal on your appeals page while you are signed in. If you cannot reach it, write to {contact} and quote the reference above.
enforcementStatement.appealSuspended: Your account is suspended, so you may not be able to sign in. If you are still signed in on a device, you can appeal on your appeals page. Otherwise, write to {contact} and quote the reference above.
enforcementStatement.noAppeal: This decision cannot be appealed on the appeals page. If you think it is wrong, write to {contact}.
enforcementStatement.courts: You can also take the dispute to an out-of-court dispute settlement body where one is available to you, or to the courts.
enforcementStatement.restrictionOther: A restriction on your content or account
enforcementStatement.restriction.visibil: Your content was hidden while a request is decided
Your stream was limited while a moderator reviews it
Your channel was labelled mature (adults only)
enforcementStatement.clause.mature.unlab: Mature content without the mature label
enforcementStatement.legalBasis.us.take-: the United States TAKE IT DOWN Act
